page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is an x86_64 instance configuration built on dedicated AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. The instance provides 90 vCPUs derived from 45 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The memory subsystem consists of 720 GB of RAM, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Integrated storage is provided via 3,216 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity partitioned across eight drives. Hardware acceleration is limited to the host CPU, as no discrete graphics processing units are provisioned. The CPU features 32 MB of L3 cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, alongside vector extensions including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16.

Benchmark evaluations position the multi-core processing performance of this instance in the top tier, scoring 129,175.86 on multi-core stress-ng tests and 87,474.24 on PassMark CPU. Extended instructions and encryption benchmarks also exhibit top-tier results, reflecting hardware support for VAES and SHA-NI. Synthetic compilation via Clang achieved 60,820.0, and Redis SET throughput reached 118.1 million operations per second. Memory throughput tests show strong read speeds reaching 217.31 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB blocks, although write bandwidth for identical block sizes registers an average 77.28 GB/sec. Single-threaded metrics, including Geekbench single-core (1,879.0) and compression utilities, perform within the middle fifty percent of cloud instances.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the high ratio of memory per core combined with dedicated physical compute enables consolidation of memory-heavy tasks without over-provisioning compute nodes. The bundled NVMe storage delivers high-throughput scratch space and temporary caching without the overhead of network-attached block devices. The primary tradeoff lies in the variance between exceptional multi-threaded performance and moderate single-thread execution rates. This system profile fits in-memory database deployments, distributed caching tiers such as Redis, large-scale software compilation, ETL pipelines, and data processing architectures that saturate high core counts and benefit from expansive local storage.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is an x86_64 general-purpose and memory-dense instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. It provides 90 vCPUs across 45 physical cores, accompanied by 720 GB of system memory, delivering an 8 GB per vCPU allocation. The hardware platform includes 3,216 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage across eight disks, while excluding discrete GPU acceleration. In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier multi-threaded processing power, registering 129,175.86 on stress-ng and achieving strong memory bandwidth alongside 118.1 million Redis SET operations per second. Hardware instruction support spans AVX-512, VAES, and SHA-NI, which accelerates data encryption and vector processing. Although single-thread throughput and uncached write bandwidth remain average, the dense core allocation and high RAM volume yield favorable resource efficiency for demanding tasks. The instance is suited for enterprise in-memory databases, large data caching layers, real-time analytics engines, and high-concurrency compilation pipelines requiring low-latency scratch storage.
